# v0.0.11 — blank page fix: evergreen WebView2 runtime, hardened init
- Fixed the blank page area (WebView2 init failing with 0x8007139F): the app now uses the evergreen WebView2 runtime instead of preferring Edge Beta, which stopped hosting on some boots. If no stable runtime is installed, the WebView2 loader still falls back to Beta/Dev/Canary on its own.
- A shipped `WebView2Runtime` folder next to the exe is now actually picked up (the check never matched before).
- Init hardening: one retry loop instead of a retry storm, ~5 minutes of self-healing, and cleanup of this app's own orphaned browser processes between attempts (other apps' WebView2 processes are left alone).
- Fixed the crash when the window loses focus (Opacity on the frameless window).
- Diagnostics: init failures and the resolved runtime (`RUNTIME <version> folder=...`) are logged to `%TEMP%\fc-init.log`.
